Hi Sara / Tom,

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation and lots of alignment on the use case (real-time search + reranking). Per our discussion, the next best step is a technical deep dive/demo with your engineering lead to walk through the architecture, integration points, and expected latency/cost tradeoffs.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Thu, Apr 8 — 10:00–11:00am PT
- Fri, Apr 9 — 11:00am–12:00pm PT

Who should join from your side? You mentioned an engineering lead and a product owner — if you can confirm names that helps us set the agenda. We’ll have Marissa (Solutions Engineer) and myself from Redwood.

If one of those times works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short agenda + pre-demo checklist (so we can make the session productive).

Next steps: please confirm preferred time and attendee list by EOD Monday.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Rafael
